name: Cosmic Ventworks
introDiscord: Ancient vents pump blue fire through the trench while Cosmic Vent Crabs march between them like tiny maintenance workers. One enormous vent has a handwritten sign: 'GERALD. DO NOT ANGER.'
introTwitch: Ancient vents pump blue fire through the trench while Cosmic Vent Crabs march between them like tiny maintenance workers. One enormous vent has a handwritten sign: 'GERALD. DO NOT ANGER.'

cosmic-ventworks-approach.prompt: Three routes wind between hissing vents and extremely busy crabs.

left.message: Shizuki left a tonic beside Gerald. "Gerald is a vent. Glimmer insists Gerald has personality. I am remaining neutral."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic beside Gerald. Gerald continues being a vent.

right.message: A Cosmic Vent Crab clacks its claws and refuses to let you pass its workstation.

forward.message: A star-chart coffer lies beneath a pipe that appears to have been repaired entirely with shells.

cosmic-ventworks-depths.prompt: The Ventworks grow louder. Crabs shuffle between three routes carrying pieces of cometglass.

left.message:
A Berry sits beside Gerald's second sign:

"GERALD UPDATE:
Still vent.
Still hot.
Glimmer says hello."

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary has been incorporated into a crab's carefully organized scrap pile.

forward.message:
A Cosmic Vent Crab sees you approaching its scrap pile.

Union negotiations have failed.

cosmic-ventworks-threshold.prompt: Blue fire illuminates the approach to Forge of Blue Fire.

left.message: A Vent Crab blocks the route while standing heroically in front of a pipe it definitely did not install.

right.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Gerald-approved medicine." A smaller note adds: "Gerald cannot approve things."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave Gerald-approved medicine alone. Gerald offers no comment.

forward.message:
"A cometglass seam glows behind the machinery."

BOSS:

boss-antechamber.name: Forge of Blue Fire
boss-antechamber.prompt: The ordinary crabs abandon their tools as the entire Ventworks begins glowing blue.

bossPromptDiscord:
An enormous claw rises through the Forge of Blue Fire.

Gerald remains completely uninvolved.

Use /yes to approach the Forge or /no to remain with the only trustworthy vent in the area.
bossPromptTwitch:
An enormous claw rises through the Forge of Blue Fire.

Gerald remains completely uninvolved.

Use !yes to approach the Forge or !no to remain with the only trustworthy vent in the area.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat toward Gerald.

Gerald remains a vent.

Reliable.

boss.revealText:
Blue fire erupts as an enormous armored crab rises from the machinery.

Starforge Clawlord reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Forge settles.

The Cosmic Vent Crabs immediately return to work.

Gerald survives.

The important lore has been preserved."
